verdict.rationale: The README gives each skill a plain description of what it does: recon, planning, design system, build, backend, QA, parity, reviews, rebrand, launch and deploy. It also states that skills are invoked by slash command (e.g. /replica-backend, /replica-entrepreneur) and run in order, each reading the previous skill's output in the replica/ folder. That covers 'what it does', but 'when it activates' is only implied by manual slash invocation and run order. No evidence shows per-skill activation triggers or the SKILL.md descriptions that would govern automatic activation. missing for 10: documented per-skill activation/trigger conditions, evidence of whether skills can auto-activate, independent corroboration that the documentation makes behavior predictable.
